name: Pichi Fechi! Develop
original_name: ピチふぇち！ でべろっぷ
source:
Create swimsuits like no one has ever seen before!

You're the CEO of a mid-level clothing company. Things have been slow for a while, but the swimsuit you created with your secretary Tsuruta was a smash hit! Now all your "production meetings" (with just Tsuruta, of course) happen after hours. Keep at it to unlock more styles and colors!

Create new suits, have more sex, and make your company flourish!

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ204009.html/]DLsite English[/url]]
